fields.description: Weekly issue featuring local Miami social and nightlife gossip columns ("They Tell Me," "Things I'd Like to Know"), extensive horse-racing coverage and tips for Hialeah/Tropical Park (including lists of horses "ready to go" and a turfman interview), commentary on Miami Chamber of Commerce efforts involving state societies, and discussion of Dade County liquor licensing/enforcement. Includes a letter to the editor from Mrs. Albert Haupt thanking the paper for coverage of the death of her son George Downs ("Skeets" Downs), along with numerous advertisements for clubs, bars, restaurants, services, and local businesses in Miami and Miami Beach.
